N. 294, No. 81 ); — ᵐ5 Ματταθιας , etc; — 1 a Levitical musician , מַתִּתְיָ֫הוּ 1Chr 15:18 , 21 ; 25:3 , 21 = מַתִּתְיָה 16:5 . 2 מַתִּתְיָה , Levitical name 1Chr 9:31 . 3 ׳מ , attendant of Ezra (also Levite ?)
